title: Quick-DNA™ FFPE Kit Protocol
author: Zymo Research
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.giybufw

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sample
steps.instruction: Trim excess paraffin wax from the sample and transfer it to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Use up to 25 mg tissue from a paraffin block or up to four (4) tissue sections (≤20 μm thick) with a total surface area ~20 cm².
It is recommended to start with 1-2 sections.
Note: If using fresh/frozen tissue specimens, proceed directly to Proteinase K Digestion & DNA Isolation.

steps.title: Deparaffinize Sample
steps.instruction: Remove paraffin from the tissue sample using Deparaffinization Solution or Xylene.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 μl of Deparaffinization Solution to the sample.
Incubate at 55°C for 1 minute.
Vortex briefly.
Remove Deparaffinization Solution from the sample.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the deparaffinized tissue sample (≤ 25 mg) in a microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Add the digestion mixture to the sample. (Note: If tissue sample is too large for the digestion volume, scale up digestion to 200 μl while keeping Proteinase K amount the same; double reagent volumes in Step 8 & 9 of DNA Purification section).

Choose digestion time: Rapid Digestion (incubate at 55°C for 1-4 hours, recommended for slide tissue sections) or Standard Digestion (incubate at 55°C overnight/12-16 hrs for maximum yields from tough-to-lyse or large samples).
Transfer the digestion to 94°C and incubate for 20 minutes.
Add 5 μl of RNase A.
Mix and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Lysis and DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Lyse the sample and optionally precipitate specific DNA fragments.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μl of Genomic Lysis Buffer to the tube and mix thoroughly by vortexing.

To isolate total DNA > 50 bp (including ssDNA): Add 135 μl of isopropanol 1 (user supplied), mix thoroughly, and centrifuge at ≥ 12,000 x g for 1 minute to remove insoluble debris. (Note: Skip these two sub-actions to isolate only DNA > 500 bp).

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a Zymo-Spin™ IIC Column 2 in a Collection Tube (maximum loading volume is ~700 μl).
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Wash DNA
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 μl of Genomic DNA Wash 1 to the spin column in a new Collection Tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1 minute and discard the flow-through.
Add 700 μl of Genomic DNA Wash 2 to the spin column.
Centrifuge at ≥ 12,000 x g for 1 minute and discard the flow-through.
Add 200 μl of Genomic DNA Wash 2 to the spin column.
Centrifuge at ≥ 12,000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Recover the purified DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the Zymo-Spin™ IIC Column to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

Add ≥ 50 μl DNA Elution Buffer 3 or water (add ≥ 100 μl if sampling 25 mg tissue). Note: If using water, ensure pH > 6.0. Yield may be improved by pre-equilibrating buffer/water to 60-70°C or pooling sequential elutions.
Incubate 2-5 minutes at room temperature.
Centrifuge at top speed for 30 seconds to elute the DNA.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Use the eluted DNA immediately for molecular applications or store at ≤-20°C.
